description: This file contains utility functions for string manipulation, byte order setting, and CRC32 checksum calculation, used within the WebRTC operator component of the Android Open Source Project.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter character or separator string.

methods.name: StartsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: StringPrintf
methods.description: Formats a string using printf-style formatting.

methods.name: SET_U16
methods.description: Sets a 16-bit unsigned integer into a byte buffer in big-endian order.

methods.name: SET_U32
methods.description: Sets a 32-bit unsigned integer into a byte buffer in big-endian order.

methods.name: computeCrc32
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum of a data buffer.
